result.stdout:
LiteGraphConsole

Usage:
  lg --database litegraph.db --tenant <guid> --graph <guid>
  lg --endpoint http://localhost:8000 --tenant <guid> --graph <guid> --token <bearer>
  lg --database litegraph.db --tenant <guid> --graph <guid> --execute "MATCH (n) RETURN n LIMIT 5"
  lg --database litegraph.db --tenant <guid> --graph <guid> --script queries.lg

Arguments:
  --database, --file, -d <path>       SQLite database file
  --endpoint <url>                    LiteGraph REST endpoint
  --tenant <guid>                     Tenant GUID
  --graph <guid>                      Graph GUID
  --token <token>                     Bearer token for endpoint mode
  --security-token <token>            x-token value for endpoint mode
  --execute, -e <query>               Execute one query and exit
  --script, -s <path>                 Execute semicolon-delimited queries from a file
  --param <name=json>                 Add a query parameter
  --max-results <count>               Request MaxResults value, default 100
  --timeout <seconds>                 Request TimeoutSeconds value, default 30
  --compact                           Emit compact JSON
  --help, -h                          Show help

Interactive commands:
  .help                               Show shell commands
  .show                               Show current connection settings
  .tenant <guid>                      Set tenant GUID
  .graph <guid>                       Set graph GUID
  .database <path>                    Switch to local SQLite database mode
  .endpoint <url>                     Switch to REST endpoint mode
  .token <token>                      Set bearer token
  .param set <name> <json>            Set a query parameter
  .param unset <name>                 Remove a query parameter
  .param clear                        Clear query parameters
  .read <path>                        Execute queries from a file
  .mode pretty|compact                Set JSON output mode
  .quit, .exit                        Exit
